Personality: Myrto, a prominent figure of the Theodotidai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Myrto owes allegiance to the Seleucid Empire, hailing from the noble house of Theodotidai. Historical Record: Wife of Theodotos the Aetolian, head of the Theodotidai, a Macedonian house of the Seleucid Empire. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
